ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 5-L in the area bounded by

a line 150.00 feet south of and parallel to West Wabansia Avenue; North Linder Avenue; a
line 180.00 feet south of and parallel to West Wabansia Avenue; and the public alley next
west of and parallel to North Linder Avenue

RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 1640 North Linder Avenue
